title: Cloud Security: service regions
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for service regions.

## Basis

Regional usage multipliers: Map from service region to multiplicative usage rate factor; decimal mapping.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Regional usage multipliers |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12 |

## Tier comparison

The listed service regions bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
